content: rai_whoami builds an EmbodimentInfo from a directory of docs/images/URDF via 'python src/rai_whoami/rai_whoami/build_whoami.py <dir> --build-vector-db'; can also embed docs into a vector DB for RAG-style retrieval. Loaded at agent startup with EmbodimentInfo.from_directory(path) and converted to a system prompt with whoami.to_langchain(). Not a running ROS node by default -- it's a build-time artifact consumed at agent process start. Source: robotecai.github.io/rai, github.com/RobotecAI/rai README.
